_comment: Expected `gn check` error count per platform, for the LEGACY patch base.
`gn check` is advisory — Chromium's own build does not consume it — but the
count must not drift unwatched, so tools/build.sh treats a mismatch in
EITHER direction as fatal: more errors is a regression to attribute, fewer
means this file is stale and must be lowered in the change that fixed them.
These are NOT a clean bill of health. They cannot currently be attributed by
differencing against an unpatched tree, because the committed GN args do not
configure one (docs/astro-next/baseline/findings.md, findings 7 and 8).
Curating them belongs to https://github.com/OxyHQ/Astro/issues/8.
A platform with no entry here is a hard failure, not a pass — an unmeasured
platform must not look like a clean one.
WHY 42 AND NOT 26 (raised 2026-08-09, in the change that measured it).
26 was recorded on 2026-08-06. `057-oxy-webui-build-edge.patch` landed on
2026-08-08 and put chrome/browser/oxy into the build graph for the first
time, so from that commit onward `gn check` also visits the overlay's own
include edges — 16 of them are violations, and every one of them predates
this file's previous value. The number was never re-measured after 057, so
the 26 has been describing a graph the repository no longer builds.
Attributed by SPLITTING the report rather than by differencing, which the
findings above say is not available: of 42 errors, 26 name no overlay path
at all — exactly the previous baseline, unchanged — and 16 name one. The 16
are Chromium files reaching into the overlay (browser_about_handler.cc,
chrome_content_browser_client.cc, browser_navigator.cc, profile_menu_view.cc,
tab_helpers.cc, side_panel_util.cc, search.cc, toolbar_view.cc) plus two
inside it (oxy_auth_token_store.cc → chrome/common/chrome_paths.h,
astro_adblock_toolbar_button.h → chrome/browser/ui/views/toolbar/).
Each is a missing GN dependency edge on a target the overlay's integration
patches write into; #7 and #8 own them.
The F2-A change that raised this number introduced THREE such errors of its
own and then removed all three by putting each edge on the target that
actually compiles the file — //chrome/browser/profiles:profiles_extra_parts_impl
for patch 062, //chrome/browser for 063, //chrome/common:constants for the
theming target. A new hook must do the same rather than add to this count.
